User Stories: As a Seller, I want to download the CSV template and instruction sheet.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall provide the template with all required columns (name, style_tags, front_image_filename, rear_image_filename — no occasion_tags) plus the instruction sheet (FR-4.1 v1.1).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Seller Dashboard
2. Click Download CSV Template
3. Verify columns and instruction sheet download

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Seller logged in; valid CSV + images ready
User Stories: As a Seller, I want to upload my catalog items.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall process images with rembg, generate transparent PNGs, queue validation, and publish accepted items under the Store Name (FR-4.2).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Seller Dashboard
2. Upload CSV
3. Upload Front/Rear images
4. Verify rembg processing and validation report

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Seller logged in; image file 6 MB prepared
User Stories: As a Seller, I want to upload an item. The image exceeds 5 MB.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall reject with "exceeds 5 MB" reason (FR-4.7(b)).
Steps to Test:
1. Upload a CSV item with a 6 MB image
2. Verify rejection reason in report

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Seller logged in; 700×700 px image prepared
User Stories: As a Seller, I want to upload an item. The image is below 800×800 px.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall reject with "below 800×800" reason (FR-4.7(b)).
Steps to Test:
1. Upload a CSV item with a 700×700 px image
2. Verify rejection reason in report

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Seller logged in; CSV missing a required field
User Stories: As a Seller, I want to upload an item. A required field is missing.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall reject with "Missing field: [fieldname]" (FR-4.7(a)).
Steps to Test:
1. Upload a CSV missing the price field
2. Verify rejection reason names the missing field

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Seller logged in; item declared "red" with blue-dominant image
User Stories: As a Seller, I want to upload an item. The declared color does not match the image.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall reject with "Image color doesn't match description" (FR-4.7(e)).
Steps to Test:
1. Upload an item declared color "red" with a blue-dominant image
2. Verify color-mismatch rejection

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Seller logged in; CSV filename has no matching uploaded image
User Stories: As a Seller, I want to upload an item. The CSV filename doesn't match any uploaded image.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall reject with a filename-mapping reason (FR-4.7(d)).
Steps to Test:
1. Upload a CSV referencing a filename not uploaded
2. Verify filename-mapping rejection

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Seller logged in; image that fails background removal
User Stories: As a Seller, I want to upload an item. Background removal failed.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall reject the item with a descriptive rembg failure reason; no partial publish (FR-4.7, FR-4.8).
Steps to Test:
1. Upload an image that fails rembg
2. Verify descriptive rejection reason

User Stories: As a Seller, I want to see which items were accepted and rejected.
Acceptance Criteria: The report shall show accepted items, rejected items with reasons, and summary stats (FR-4.8).
Steps to Test:
1. Upload a mixed valid/invalid CSV
2. Open the Validation Report
3. Verify accepted/rejected sections and reasons

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Seller logged in; CSV with 11 items prepared
User Stories: As a Seller, I want to upload 11 items in one CSV.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall reject the upload with a max-batch message (UC-16 ext; SRS §4.1: up to 10 items per CSV).
Steps to Test:
1. Upload a CSV with 11 items
2. Verify rejection with max-batch (10 items) message

User Stories: As a Seller, I want to edit a listing.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall revalidate the updated item and update the catalog entry (UC-19).
Steps to Test:
1. Open My Listings
2. Click Edit on an item
3. Modify metadata/image
4. Save
5. Verify revalidation and catalog update

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Seller with an item in an active cart
User Stories: As a Seller, I want to delete a listing.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall remove the item from the catalog, warn if in active carts, and retain past-order snapshots (UC-19 ext, FR-6.8).
Steps to Test:
1. Add the item to a User's cart
2. As Seller, delete the listing
3. Verify warning and confirm
4. Verify catalog removal and order-history snapshot retained

User Stories: As a Registered User, I attempted to access the Seller Dashboard.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall deny non-sellers access to Seller endpoints server-side (FR-1.7).
Steps to Test:
1. Log in as a Registered User
2. Attempt to open Seller Dashboard/upload
3. Verify access denied (403)

User Stories: As a Seller, I want my upload processed quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: 10-item CSV processes within ≤60 seconds, including rembg and validation (Criterion 4).
Steps to Test:
1. Upload 10-item CSV + 20 images.
2. Start timer.
3. Stop timer when validation report appears.

User Stories: As a Seller, I want my items published without manual fixes.
Acceptance Criteria: ≥80% of CSV-uploaded items publish without manual correction during UAT (Criterion 5).
Steps to Test:
1. Seller uploads 10 items unassisted.
2. Calculate % accepted on first try.

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Seller logged in; valid CSV and Front and Rear source images prepared
User Stories: As a Seller, I want the processed Front and Rear images to have valid transparency data.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall generate Front and Rear PNG images with valid alpha channels (FR-4.7(c)).
Steps to Test:
1. Upload a valid catalog item with Front and Rear source images.
2. Wait for image processing to complete.
3. Inspect the generated Front PNG and verify it has a valid alpha channel.
4. Inspect the generated Rear PNG and verify it has a valid alpha channel.
5. Record the result for each image.

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Seller logged in; valid item prepared with a color-family value whose knowledge-table mapping is known
User Stories: As a Seller, I want compatible color-palette tags to be generated automatically from the item's color-family value.
Acceptance Criteria: After successful validation and publishing, the system shall generate the item's compatible color-palette tags from its color-family value using the encoded color-theory knowledge table. The Seller shall not need to provide these tags in the CSV (FR-3.2; FR-4.2; FR-7.1).
Steps to Test:
1. Prepare a valid item using a color-family value with a known mapping in the knowledge table.
2. Upload and publish the item without providing color-palette tags in the CSV.
3. Inspect the item's saved metadata.
4. Verify the generated color-palette tags match the knowledge-table mapping for that color-family value.
5. Record the expected and actual tags.

User Stories: As a Seller, I attempted an Excel (.xlsx) upload.
Acceptance Criteria: System rejects non-CSV files with "File must be a CSV"; no batch created (SRS §1.2; FR-4.1).
Steps to Test: 1. Upload .xlsx 2. Verify rejection message 3. Verify no batch created

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Seller logged in; CSV with style_tags "streetwear"
User Stories: As a Seller, I used a style tag outside the controlled vocabulary.
Acceptance Criteria: Row rejected with invalid style_tags reason listing allowed values: casual, smart, formal, sporty (FR-3.2, FR-4.7(a)).
Steps to Test: 1. Upload CSV with "streetwear" 2. Verify reason names the tag and lists allowed values
